en: Colorized vintage view of a large neoclassical building complex with two symmetrical pavilions topped by red hipped roofs and small lanterns. The main façade faces a formal garden with a large lawn and colorful flowerbeds in the foreground, lined with trees along a path. A tram or trolley is visible on the right side in front of the building. The scene is under a partly cloudy blue sky and has the soft, grainy look of early color printing. No visible caption or text appears on the front.
